text:
SEMKIT-056 says texts sort in the order of sort-words (ё after е), but sort-words orders by character codes (ё after я).
Question: Which text order does sort-rows use?
Options:
1. ё after е
2. character codes, as sort-words
Recommended: ё after е
context: SEMKIT-056 says texts sort in the order of sort-words (ё after е), but sort-words orders by character codes (ё after я).
question: Which text order does sort-rows use?
note: Option 1: ё after е (Russian alphabet order: е, ё, ж). The task text wrongly tied it to sort-words; sort-words stays as it is. Say the order in the sort-rows help.
